verses.text: Ayik wanxo sk'ik'b'i ix k'och chawanh heb' ángel chi' t'a chonhab' Sodoma. Ha winhaj Lot k'ojanek' winh t'a spuertail chonhab' chi'. Ix yilan winh to wan sja heb', ix k'e wa'an winh b'at schakot heb'. Ix em nhojnaj winh t'a yichanh heb'.

Ix yalan winh: --Ex mamin, tzin tewi t'ayex, koyek wet' t'a in pat. Ay ha ha' b'aj ol he b'ikel eyok, ay pax b'aj wach' ol ex kan t'a jun ak'wal tik, haxo k'ik'an spet ex b'ati, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach, palta a onh tik ol onh kan t'a calle tik, a tik ol onh wayok, xchi heb'.
Palta ix och wal tean winhaj Lot chi' t'a heb', masanto ix b'at heb' t'a spat winh chi'. Haxo ix k'och heb', ix sb'o'an ixim pan winh malaj yich swa heb', ix wa heb' sik'lab'il.
Ayik mantzak way heb', ix k'och masanil heb' winh winak kajan chi' ta', ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak spat winhaj Lot chi'.

Ix och ijan heb' winh yawajoch t'a winhaj Lot chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayek' juntzanh heb' winh winak ix jakan t'a a pat tik t'a jun ak'wal tik? Ik'elta heb' winh t'ayonh yik skixtej heb', xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel winhaj Lot chi', ix elta winh yil heb' winh. Wach' ix yutej winh smakankanelta te' puerta chi' t'a spatik.
Ix yalan winh: --Ex wetanimail, tzin tewi t'ayex to manh he k'ulej jun chukal chi'.

Ay chawanh heb' ix wisil kob'estak, mantalaj winak tzek' t'a spatik heb' ix, syal wik'anelta heb' ix t'ayex yik tze k'ulej icha he gana chi' yet' heb' ix. Palta a yet' heb' winh tik, max yal-laj, yujto tonhej ix jakan heb' winh t'a in pat tik, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh: --Manh ak'och a b'a, elanh t'a kichanh. Ha ach tik ch'ok chonhab'il ach, ¿tom a ach ijan tzala'? Ha tiknaik ek'b'al ol ach kixtej t'a yichanh heb' winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix och ijan heb' winh yekanel winhaj Lot chi' yik sk'och heb' winh t'a te' puerta chi', yik smak'anpoj te' heb' sna'ani.
Palta a chawanh heb' ángel chi', ix yak'elta sk'ab' heb' yik tz'ik'jioch winhaj Lot chi' yuj heb' t'a yol pat chi', ix smakanelta te' puerta chi' heb'.
Ix yak'an k'ik'yatax heb' anima ayek' t'a patik pat chi' heb', heb' icham winak yet' heb' kelemtak, ix te k'unb'i heb' sayanek' sti' te' pat chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' chawanh chi' t'a winhaj Lot: --Tato ayto heb' ay uj a b'a yet'ok t'a tik, heb' winh uninal, heb' ix isil, heb' a nhi', ma heb' a k'ab'ok, ik'el heb' t'a tik.
Yujto ol ko satel jun chonhab' tik. Yujto ix te' k'ek'och schukal heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' onh schekkoti yik tzul ko satel juntzanh anima tik, xchi heb' ángel chi'.

Yuj chi', ix b'at winhaj Lot chi' yal t'a heb' winh t'inhan yik'lan sb'a yet' heb' ix yisil chi', ix yalan winh: --Pilek eyip, konh elek, yujto a jun chonhab' tik ol satel yuj Jehová, xchi winh t'a heb'. Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' tas ix yal winhaj Lot chi'. Tonhej spukhan winh sna'an heb'.

Palta haxo yik wanxo sakb'i, ix yalan heb' ángel chi' t'a winhaj Lot chi': --Pil ip tato max yal a k'ol tzach satel yet' jun chonhab' tik. Ik'b'at ix etb'eyum tik yet' heb' ix isil tik schawanhil, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Palta a winhaj Lot chi', max spil-laj yip winh yeli. Yuj chi' a heb' ángel chi' ix ketzan sk'ab' heb' schanhwanhil, yik tz'ik'jiel heb', yujto tz'ok' sk'ol Jehová t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'jiel winhaj Lot yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' ix yisil t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayik toxo ix el heb' t'a stiel chonhab' chi', ix yalan junok heb' ángel chi' t'a heb': --Yelk'olal tzex b'ati, manh ex meltzajkot k'elan t'a he patik. Manh ex och wa'an he b'ey t'a jun ak'lik tik, k'eanhek t'a jolomtak witz, tato max yal he k'ol tzex sateli, xchi t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Lot chi': --Ma'ay mamin, yuj wal Dios t'ayex.
Te niwanxo he wach'k'olal ix he ch'ox t'ayin, ina ix in eyik'elta yik max in chami. Palta max yal-laj in b'atkan t'a jolomtak witz chi', tekan tzin yamchajk'och yuj jun ya'elal chi', tzin chami.
Ha t'a slak'anil tik ay jun yune' chonhab', tzam yal in b'atkan t'ay. ¿Tom max yala' tzin he chab'at ta' yik tzin kol in b'a? Wal yel yunenhej jun chonhab' chi', xchi winhaj Lot chi'.
Ix yalan jun ángel chi': --Toxo ix wab'i, yik'okab' icha tzal chi'. Manh ol in satel jun chonhab' ix al chi'.
Elanhchamel he b'ati, yujto malaj tas syal in b'o'ani ta maxto ex k'och ta', xchi jun ángel chi'. Yuj chi' Zoar ix sb'iejkan jun chonhab' chi'.
Ayik wan sjawi k'u ix k'och winhaj Lot chi' t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankot k'ak' Jehová yet' azufre t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra chi'.
Ix satel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'ay yet' masanil jun niwan ak'lik chi' yet' tas sk'ib' t'ay.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Lot chi', najat tzak'anto skot ix, ix meltzajxikanb'at k'elan ix t'a spatik. Hata' ix ochkan ix atz'amil.
Haxo t'a yewial slolon winhaj Abraham yet' Jehová, t'a k'inhib'alil, ix b'at winh b'aj lolon heb' chi'.
Haxo ix yilan winh to a Sodoma yet' Gomorra yet' masanil jun ak'lik chi', b'akakixonhej sk'e stab'il icha sk'e stab'il junok niwan horno.

Ayik ix satjiel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj Dios t'a jun niwan ak'lik b'aj ix ek' kajan winhaj Lot chi', ix sna'ankot Dios tas ix sk'an winhaj Abraham, yuj chi' ix kolchaj winhaj Lot chi' t'a skal jun niwan ya'elal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix xiw winhaj Lot skajnaj t'a chonhab' Zoar chi', yuj chi' ix k'ekan winh t'a jolomtak witz yet' heb' ix yisil schawanhil, ix kajnaj heb' t'a yol jun k'e'en nhak'e'en.
Ay jun k'ual ix yal ix b'ab'el ix t'a ix snulej: --Ha winh ko mam tik, te ichamxo winh, malaj junok winak t'a jun lugar tik syal kik'lan ko b'a yet'ok icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima.
Yuj chi' kak' yuk' anh winh ko mam tik, yik ol onh way yet' winh, yik wach' ol kan yinhtilal winh ket'ok, xchi ix.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak' anh heb' ix yuk' winh, ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winh. Yuj chi' a ix b'ab'el ix, ix way yet' winh. Maj yab' winh janik' ix way ix yet'ok, maj yab'pax winh janik' ix k'exwan ix t'a stz'ey.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix yalan ix b'ab'el chi' t'a ix snulej chi': --Ha k'ik'i t'ak'wal ix in way yet' winh ko mam tik, haxo tiknaik kak'xi anh yuk' winh yik wach' tzach way yet' winh yik ol kan yinhtilal winh ket' ko chawanhil, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak'anxi anh heb' ix yuk' winh smam chi', haxo ix schab'il chi' ix way yet' winh. Palta a winhaj Lot chi', maj yab' winh janik' ix way ix yet'ok, maj yab'pax winh janik' ix k'exwan ix.
Icha chi' ix aj yochkan heb' ix yisil winh chi' schawanhil yab'ixal yuj.
Ha ix b'ab'el, ix alji yune' ix, Moab ix yak' ix sb'iej, haton winh aykan yinhtilal heb' moabita tiknaik.
Ix aljipax yune' ix schab'il chi', Ben-ammi, ix yak' ix sb'iej, haton winh aykan yinhtilal heb' amonita tiknaik.
